name: HIST 5475
title: Histories of the Body: European Perspectives since 1500
description: Historical and interdisciplinary approaches to the study of the body and the European imagination since 1500.  Topics include: representations of health and illness; the body as a site of law and sovereign power; sexed bodies; the body in social and political theory; the government of life and death; race and ethnicity.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
